rtl_guidelines.css_logical_properties: CRITICAL: Use logical properties instead of directional ones. Use ms-* (margin-inline-start) instead of ml-*. Use pe-* (padding-inline-end) instead of pr-*. Use border-s-* instead of border-l-*.
rtl_guidelines.alignment: text-start instead of text-left. text-end instead of text-right.
rtl_guidelines.icons: Ensure directional icons (arrows, chevrons) are flipped for RTL using transform rotate-180 or appropriate Lucide-react/Phosphor icons.
rtl_guidelines.sidebar: Sidebar must be positioned on the RIGHT side. Main content on the LEFT.

instructions_to_main_agent.general: Build a modern Arabic RTL Dashboard tailored for schools/fitness registration.
instructions_to_main_agent.fonts: Include the Google Font 'Alexandria' and 'Cairo'. Apply to Tailwind config.
instructions_to_main_agent.shadcn: When installing Shadcn UI components, ensure you customize them to respect RTL (Tailwind logical properties). Some components (like tabs or dropdowns) may require explicitly setting dir='rtl' on Radix primitives.
instructions_to_main_agent.accessibility_and_testing: MANDATORY: Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements, buttons, form inputs, and key informational elements (e.g., data-testid='student-registration-submit').
instructions_to_main_agent.bmi_calc: In the Student Registration form, BMI should auto-calculate (Weight in kg / (Height in m)^2) and instantly display the result with corresponding color tags defined in bmi_logic_colors.
instructions_to_main_agent.icons: Use lucide-react. Flip icons like ArrowRight to point Left in RTL (e.g., className='rotate-180').
